nodes.title: Note: About HuMo
widgets_values: HuMo is a human-centric video generation tool that creates controllable, high-quality human videos from multimodal inputs (text, images, audio), supporting text-image guided customization, text-audio driven audio-motion sync, and 480P(832x480)/720P(1280x720) resolutions.
